consumer: pickup.cpp pick_up_from_items's input loop, which asks the player via an interactive menu which ground-pile items to select and finalize for pickup
scope: the ground-item stack reachable at the pickup tile (map::i_at the pile on the ground), not the avatar's own carried items
decisive_source: src/pickup.cpp::pick_up_from_items — registers UP/DOWN/RIGHT/CONFIRM/QUIT and runs ctxt.handle_input() to mark selections and finalize on CONFIRM, an interactive menu over the active input loop
divergence: a pile holding multiple stacks where the player intends to take only one stack: a snapshot-serializer answer (Excerpt 1/3) would render the items but never drive the selection, so no item is actually marked/picked up while a B-authority menu would consume the chosen stack through handle_input
